stem.text: A piece of conducting putty (modelling clay) of constant resistivity is formed into a cylindrical shape.
The resistance $R$ between its flat ends (shaded) is measured.

stem.alt: Diagram of a cylinder with shaded flat circular ends, with its length L marked by a double-headed arrow between the ends.

stem.text: The same volume of putty is re-formed into cylinders of different lengths $L$, and the resistance $R$ between the flat ends is measured for each value of $L$.
Which graph best shows the variation of $R$ with $L$?

A.alt: Graph of R against L with the axes labelled R and L and origin marked 0; a horizontal line is drawn at a constant height.

B.alt: Graph of R against L with the axes labelled R and L and origin marked 0; a straight line starts at the origin and rises to the right.

C.alt: Graph of R against L with the axes labelled R and L and origin marked 0; a curve starts at the origin, rises and flattens to the right.

D.alt: Graph of R against L with the axes labelled R and L and origin marked 0; a curve starts at the origin and rises steeply to the right.
